applies_from: E2 combat integration (CP8/CP12); E2b host-fight QA (CP13)
host_action: copy this worktree contracts/bridge-v1.json AND contracts/bridge-v1.1-delta.json to the canonical .scratch/contracts path

state_fields.meaning: KERNEL_FRAME(24) = actual 30 Hz Kernel::getFrameNum() gameplay tick; FRAME(19) remains the ~84/s render-loop pass counter. TARGET_* (25..34) = read-only report of the nearest hostile Actor the avatar is fighting near (real engine alignment predicate; neutral actors such as Devon never match). TARGET_SCREEN_X/Y (32/33) are GameMapGump::GetLocationOfItem(...,256) 'feet' coords in engine-logical screen space == what gesture() takes; TARGET_SCREEN_OK(34) is the validity flag. FIXTURE_* (35..38) are QA-only bookkeeping for the dev-gated hostile fixture.
state_fields.indices_unchanged: 0..24 keep their E1/v1.1 meaning; all new fields are appended.

fixture_hook.gated_by: global.Module.__bridgeQAFixture === true (engine-side EM_JS check, inert otherwise; non-Emscripten builds always false)
fixture_hook.debugger: Combat::stageHostile [shape] [hpCap]  (default hpCap 24; shape 0 = auto-pick a real melee monster)
fixture_hook.semantics: Spawns exactly ONE real Actor via ItemFactory::createActor mirroring MonsterEgg::hatch, applies the game's real MonsterInfo stats (loadMonsterStats), places it on the first canExistAt-valid adjacent tile, pins BOTH alignment directions for guaranteed hostility, and attaches a real CombatProcess targeting the avatar. No damage is fabricated; all HP changes must come from the engine's own AI/collision/animation/combat pipeline. A new stage destroys the previous fixture first (bounded to one).
fixture_hook.not_gameplay: Never reachable from normal play; exists only so a host QA run can stage a real hostile without the normal save.

engine_event_stream.js_hook_now: Module.bridgeOnEngineEvent = (type, a, b, c, d, frame) => {}
engine_event_stream.compat: E1 consumers that read (type,a,b,c) keep working; d and frame are appended.
engine_event_stream.frame_field: 6th arg: Kernel::getFrameNum() at emission, for input-latency measurement

save_semantics.save_result_event: CMD_SAVE now captures Common::Error and enqueues SAVE_RESULT(slot, ok). Enqueue-return 1 is still NOT success.
save_semantics.durability: await Ultima8Bridge.flushPersist() (real FS.syncfs callback) for durable persistence; SAVE_RESULT ok covers the engine write, flushPersist covers IndexedDB.
